faulty.text: A small marketing site with a signup form on its homepage. Stripe is switched off at this deploy. The feature under review is the hand-off from the signup form to Stripe Checkout once Stripe is on.
Closure request (harness-written): close ticket CHECKOUT-1, 'a visitor who submits the signup form with Stripe on is sent to Stripe Checkout'.
`app.js` redirects to `checkout_url` only if one is returned, which never happens while Stripe is off.

Tests: `cd staged && node tests/run.mjs` gave 54 passed, 0 failed. That includes the new Run 0, which runs with production secrets only (no ADMIN_TOKEN or STRIPE_*) and all flags forced on, and checks that admin and Stripe are refused with 503.
Unsigned or badly signed /api/twilio/voice and unsigned /api/twilio/sms get 403. Admin gets 503 with or without a token.
No calls, texts, emails or test signups were made.

The live homepage never loads `public/app.js`. `index.html` has its own **inline copy** of the signup handler. That copy checks only `j.ok` and always shows "Thanks, you're on the list", so it drops `checkout_url`.
